statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the blocking threshold because a fresh delayed NQ reference shows substantial two-sided range traversal rather than persistent extreme-holding.
recommendation: Current Tail is 21%. Extreme geopolitical, oil and rates Stress persists, while the fresh delayed NQ reference does not establish repeated failed retracements or sustained no-mean-reversion structure.
headline: WATCH before the U.S. cash open as NQ remains two-sided despite extreme external Stress
body: A fresh delayed NQ reference showed 29,559.25 within a 29,477.75-29,739.00 session range, about 81.5 points above the low after opening at the high. Reuters reported Nasdaq-100 futures near flat earlier in the premarket, while Brent remained near $99 and the U.S. 10-year yield near 4.8%. The main conditional risk remains the first post-holiday U.S. cash-open window.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hour slots, published ChatGPT Tail ranged from 17% to 27% while Stress remained at 100%. A brief trend-down elevation at 08:00 UTC subsequently reverted to WATCH and then low Tail as two-sided repair reappeared.
outlookSummary: The principal danger window is 13:20-15:00 UTC around the first post-holiday U.S. cash open. Forecast Tail is 29% in the 13:00 UTC slot and peaks conditionally at 33% at 14:00 UTC only if the opening impulse remains unrepaired, holds near an extreme and extends after failed pullbacks.
